sourceClassification.conservativeRule: Ambiguous/nontraditional/composite labels are excluded from sportsbook holdout rather than guessed into the primary cohort.

design.mainLineSelection: Within each source/player/game/market choose exact over/under line whose proportional no-vig over probability is closest to 0.50; tie-break lower absolute overround then line.
design.calibrator: Per-market logistic recalibration q=sigmoid(a+b*logit(p)); a,b fit on March-May only, then frozen for June holdout.
design.sensitivityCohort: High- and medium-confidence labels classified as traditional sportsbooks.
design.interpretation: Holdout calibration is evidence about probability calibration, not a claim of executable betting profit or book sharpness.
